deprecation_note: gemini-2.0-flash and gemini-2.5-flash are discontinued. gemini-flash-lite-latest provides stable 200 OK responses with high throughput and low latency, bypassing standard Flash 503 capacity limits.
api_key_source: Environment variable GEMINI_API_KEY loaded via python-dotenv
retrieval_method: TF-IDF cosine similarity over a local JSON guideline knowledge base
known_limitations: Requires a valid GEMINI_API_KEY with quota.
Gemini findings are advisory only and must be verified against source code.
Line numbers returned by LLMs are approximate heuristics.
External API dependency requires active internet connectivity for AI review.
Static analyzer rules provide deterministic first-pass checks, not full MISRA compliance certification.
notes: Configurable model definition read at runtime by Code/gemini_integration.py.
